scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:api
scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/types build && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/validation build && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/config build && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/ui build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/types typecheck && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/validation typecheck && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/config typecheck && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/api typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e apps/api/.env -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:status: dotenv -e apps/api/.env -- prisma migrate status --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.user:create-admin: dotenv -e apps/api/.env -- pnpm --filter @hhlawyer/api exec tsx src/scripts/create-admin.ts
